info.sub_name: 波動力學、熱力學和光學

description.sub_name: 波動力學、熱力學和光學
description.describe_ch: 這是一門以理工領域學生為對象並結合微積分的普通物理課程. 課程內容以光學和熱力學的理論和應用為主。探討的主題包含 波動、幾何光學、波動光學(例如 光干涉、光繞射、光偏極)、熱、材料熱學性質和熱力學定律。延伸主題還將包含狹義相對論與近代物理。每週另有實驗課三小時，包括各實驗單元的原理介紹與操作，透過實際的實驗與操作實習協助學生進一步理解。
description.describe_eh: This is a calculus-based general physics for students majoring in engineering or sciences. The major contents are the general principles and applications of optics and thermodynamics. Topics include wave, geometric optics, wave optics (including interference, diffraction, and polarization), heat, thermal properties of matter, and thermodynamics’ laws. The topics will also be extended to special relativity and modern physics. Besides lectures, we’ll also focus on the problem solving skills as well as the basic mathematical modeling.

targets.describe_ch: 理解光學與熱力學基本原理，並能應用於日常生活的光學與熱力學現象的解釋
targets.describe_en: Understanding the basic principles of optics and thermodynamics, and being able to apply them in the related phenomena observed in daily life

targets.describe_ch: 能架構光學或熱力學實驗，並進行分析
targets.describe_en: Being able to set up and analyze the experiments of optics or  thermodynamics.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. 所有課程活動都將在同學、教師或助教間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，且彼此間尊重、欣賞、包容每個人的經歷、背景和觀點。
2. 為確保有效學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到：言行禮貌、準時出席課堂；如有請假需求，請依照學校規定在請假系統提出申請。
3. 上課時段內勿進行與本課程無關事情，例如 閒聊、睡覺、進食(飲料不在此限)、划手機/打電動/上網....等。
4. 除非課程需要(如老師要求、學生作筆記...等)，學生會被要求將手機(或筆電、平板、耳機...等物件)放置到非觸手可及的
    位置(例如，書包袋子內、桌椅下方...等)。
5. 想與老師諮詢課業學生，建議提早一兩天與老師約定(當面或LINE訊息皆可)確認諮詢時間、地點。
    除非該位學生刻意表達希望是"一對一"諮詢，否則老師將公告此諮詢活動，並歡迎其他有興趣同學一併加入，以提升教與學的效率。
6. 課堂訊息(作業、考試、講義、.....等) 將以 (1) 課堂老師口頭或板書方式 或 (2) LINE群組 或 (3) iLearn公告 方式告知大家。
7. 學生亦可使用電子郵件(yinglee@o365.fcu.edu.tw)或LINE與老師連繫；但郵件要署名，老師不回覆“匿名”信件。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
All course activities will be carried out in an atmosphere of friendly participation and interaction among students, respecting and appreciating
each student's personal experience, background and perspectives, such as various school systems at home and abroad, diverse enrollment and
learning cultures, gender, etc. You are expected to apply the highest academic standards throughout this course and to treat fellow students with
dignity and respect.

PS 如請假系統的佐證不符合上述要求 (例如，僅出示身體不適照片或藥袋照片、所述事由無上述人士之一具名背書...等)，則老師將批示"不核准"。

Students are welcome to contact the instructors through either the face-to-face comunications or the e-mail (yinglee@o365.fcu.edu.tw)
The instructor will approve students' requesting for class leave as long as the supporting document (in either photo or image format) is attached
and fullfills one of the following situations：

3. It is provided by the departments of university or government for manatory events (such as the military service medical examination), and it
shows the student's name
and the related date.
4. It is a memo with a brief description of the event and it MUST be signed by one of the following persons:

* A personal photo, a photo of the medicine bag or clinic buildings, a note without signatures from the person aforementioned...etc will not be
accpeted as the supporting document.
